criteria.scope: Independent descriptor geometry, compressed/literal checksum and full 65536-unit mapping oracle; mandatory ASCII and final FFFF literal.
Word/run splits, one-byte feeds, malformed rehashed tables and API offset/budget/capacity conservation.
Independent volume-specific name hashes and full comparison for lengths 1..255, non-ASCII maps, surrogate units and a real hash collision.
Read-only/protected input and output guards; exact clean native, header, strict C90, imports, context, source hashes and tooling. Prior full-suite evidence is separate.
